description: Take a screenshot of a web page with Site-Shot and return it as an image. Renders in a real Chromium browser. Supports viewport/device sizing, full-page capture, country proxies, and automatic ad & cookie-banner removal (cleaner image, fewer vision tokens).

block_ads.description: Remove ads for a cleaner screenshot. Default: true.

country.description: Render through a proxy in this country, given as a two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code — "DE" for Germany, "FR" for France, "JP" for Japan. Full country names are not accepted. Auto-sets IP, language, time zone and geolocation. Full list: https://www.site-shot.com/countries

format.description: Image format. Default: png. png and webp are lossless; webp is typically about 35% smaller than png. jpeg is lossy and smallest on photo-heavy pages. WebP cannot exceed 16,383 px on a side: a taller full-page capture comes back cut at 16,383 px from the top.

full_page.description: Capture the entire scrollable page instead of just the viewport. Default: false.

height.description: Viewport height in pixels. If omitted, the Site-Shot API's own default applies — pass a value whenever the exact size matters.

max_height.description: Cap the captured height in pixels (max 20000).

strict_country.description: Error out when the requested country has no proxy available, instead of silently falling back to a US proxy. Only applies when country is set. Default: true.

url.description: The URL of the web page to capture. A bare domain like example.com is accepted (https:// is assumed).

wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after load before capturing (for SPAs/animations). If omitted, the Site-Shot API applies its own delay — leaving this out is not a zero-wait capture.

width.description: Viewport width in pixels. If omitted, the Site-Shot API's own default applies — pass a value whenever the exact size matters.

name: capture_screenshot
title: Capture website screenshot
